environment.description: IoT gateway running on ARM Cortex-A53 (Raspberry Pi 4), compiled with GCC 10.2 -O2, no stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector), ASLR disabled (echo 0 > /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space), heap allocator is dlmalloc 2.8.6 without hardening. Gateway accepts raw TCP telemetry on port 5683 (CoAP). Web dashboard served on port 8080 via lighttpd 1.4.55 with no CSP headers. External CDN script loaded without integrity verification.
